CANDIDATE for chief ack — bd-01M156VV9NAK1NVNHFG9ACW2FF: branch gemini/intaglio-fixes @ 66ec2e9 (base 6fe473d). 4 files: intaglio/.../CodexLowering.scala, cli/.../Edition.scala, intaglio/.../WarOfTheGhostsLoweringSuite.scala, cli/.../EditionSuite.scala.

#1 (HIGH, D6): CodexLowering.lower(flow, discourseLength: Int) — no longer reads flow.source.canonicalText; CLI passes model.source.canonicalText.length (Edition.scala:131), mirroring AtlasLowering (Edition.scala:107). The lowering no longer touches flow.source at all.
#2 (MEDIUM): rowOf returns Either[GraphicsError, Int]; Left(GraphicsError.InvalidExtent) on Lane(index) with index >= maxLanesPerKind or on slotOf None, instead of math.min/None coalescing onto overflow. annotationGroup folds it into the for-comprehension. NOTE: the failure paths are unreachable via the public API — LaneAllocation.allocate always places every annotation as Lane(LaneIndex.trusted(i < maxLanesPerKind)) or Overflow, and CodexFlow carries only placed annotations — so #2 is defense-in-depth, verified by inspection + the valid path still passing; no brittle private-constructor forge test added.
#3 (LOW): kindLabels labels each kind overflow row as "<wireName> overflow" when rowsPerKind > 1; when rowsPerKind == 1 the single row is labelled once (no double-label).
#4 (LOW): EditionSuite asserts twin.names == svg.names (receipt twin name-count field == SVG data-name count) alongside the existing per-name containment check.
#5 (LOW): headerGrob drops flow.source.title/id and flow.contract.horizon; draws only channels + basis + source/config checksums, matching the Atlas header boundary.

EVIDENCE: built in an isolated worktree at HEAD 6fe473d (clean committed build.sbt; the shared tree carries another actor uncommitted build.sbt + layout/ WIP I did not touch). Sibling overrides point at CLEAN checkouts of the pinned SHAs: storymodel4s@8492e43, grakern@0329c43, intaglio@596b398 (grakern main is dirty with codex-grakern-open-motes WIP, so a clean pin-0329c43 worktree was used per the general sibling-pin rule). Gate: sbt <three -D overrides> compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll — green on JVM+JS; scalafmtAll reformatted the 3 edited sources. Tests: WarOfTheGhostsLoweringSuite 8/8 JVM, 8/8 JS; EditionSuite 5/5 (includes edition re-run + receipt determinism + new name-count assertion). No -Wunused warnings in my files. Worktree-local zz-worktree-local.sbt shim (sbt-git, untracked) not committed. NOT PUSHED; awaiting chief ack.
